cache: Prepare and seal each complete CPU parent once before TRAIN truth. Reuse immutable bundles across passes with explicit total RAM bound, no crop, eviction, spill or silent recomputation fallback.
comparison_scope: Shared-data pipeline comparison, not architecture-only attribution against native competitors or exact original-paper reproduction. Do not compare focal accuracy to European span accuracy.
data: Original 20 independent 2 Mb TRAIN parents and five original 30 Mb VAL parents, all 1600 haplotypes and 10000 fixed native query focals per parent, class order EUR/EAS/AFR.
hypothesis: Does the complete TreeLoom architecture transfer to American ancestry inference, and what does sample memory add relative to a matched model with the same structural encoder and genomic GRU?
initialization: Exact separately accepted epoch30/saved600 backbone weights only, same shared structural initialization, zero initial structural outputs, zero full-arm memory output, fresh separate AdamW. Original producer exit1 and outerUNKNOWN remain accepted-artifact provenance.
primary_endpoint: Equal-parent mean macro F1 on the same 10000 native focal records for each of five validation simulations, reported in percent.
repeat_reason: New full-architecture C3 transfer and matched memory test. Existing saved600 model is the simpler backbone and is not relabelled. This condition differs from the inactive four-stage2400-update proposal and from European training.
resource_plan: CPU FP32 training may proceed in parallel with native GPU0 ARGformer after independent source/runtime review and actual ROOT admission. First scheduled updates are timed inside the full budget. No standalone token-update experiment. Proposed32MiB output,128GiB RSS and96GiB CPU bundle cache are failstops, not measured fit.
secondary_endpoints: Raw probability NLL on identical focal records
selection: After all 60 new pretruth seals, select each arm independently among passes5/10/15/20/25/30 by greatest five-parent mean macroF1, earlier pass on exact ties. All observations remain validation development data. No current scoring capability granted.
training: 30 complete passes and 600 additional full-parent updates per arm, 1200 total new updates. Both arms retain both structural residuals, two shared complete-tree traversals and complete-parent bidirectional GRU. NoMem omits only the added sample memory.
uncertainty: Per-parent estimates, sample SD across five simulation parents in percentage points and paired full-minus-NoMem differences. One optimizer seed. No claim of training-seed uncertainty or independent TEST confirmation.
